keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Searches your customers make, one per line, e.g. plumber, emergency plumber, water heater repair.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Cities, neighbourhoods or ZIP codes, one per line, e.g. Austin, TX / 78744 / Round Rock, TX. Every keyword runs for every location. A list of ZIP codes works as a coarse geo-grid.

yourBusiness.title: Your business
yourBusiness.description: How to recognise your listing: its name (or part of it), its phone number, or its Google CID. Add several for multiple locations or brands. Leave empty to just collect the rankings.

depth.title: Results to check
depth.description: 20, 40 or 60 businesses per keyword and location. Each 20 is one charged page.

includeResults.title: Include the competitor list
includeResults.description: Add every business checked (name, rating, reviews, category, address, phone, hours, CID). Off = just your rank and the top competitor, and reading stops at the page your listing is on.

trackChanges.title: Track rank changes
trackChanges.description: Remember your last rank per keyword and location and add previousRank and rankChange. History lives in your named key-value store local-rank-tracker-history.

country.title: Google country
country.description: Two-letter country code (gl), e.g. us, gb, ca, au.

language.title: Language
language.description: Interface language (hl), e.g. en, es, fr.
